name: digital-workplace
description: Docks the pixel-art Digital Workplace office beside the chat; the crew acts out Claude's real prompts, tool calls and turns.

openOnStart.title: Open the office pane at start
openOnStart.description: Open the Digital Workplace pane when a session starts. /workplace shows or hides it at any time.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: auto hides confetti and disco when the system asks for reduced motion; reduced always calms the office; full always shows everything.

theme.title: World outside the windows
theme.description: auto follows the clock of the machine Claude Code runs on.

frameRate.title: Frames per second
frameRate.description: How often a terminal redraws the office, 2 to 10 times a second. In the app the office plays as films; their frame rate is the smoothness setting.

terminalArt.title: Office art in a terminal
terminalArt.description: auto shows pictures in kitty, Ghostty and iTerm2 and coloured blocks elsewhere (Windows Terminal, VS Code, tmux). blocks or image forces one.

toolChips.title: Tool-row chips
toolChips.description: Add a one-line record under each tool call in the transcript ("Brix · Edit auth.ts ✓"). Local sessions only. Takes effect at the next session start.

walkSpeed.title: Walking speed
walkSpeed.description: How fast the crew walks: normal is the office page's own pace; slow is calmer; fast hurries to keep up with quick tool calls.

view.title: Start-up view
view.description: split: two rooms, the Boardroom pinned beside the room where the work is (Open office while working, Town hall when shipping). single: one room, the camera follows the work and visits the Boardroom only for briefings.

layout.title: Room layout
layout.description: With 2 or 3 rooms in view. auto: one above another in a tall pane, side by side in a wide one, whichever draws the rooms larger. stacked or side: always that way.

smoothness.title: Animation smoothness
smoothness.description: Frames per second of the office in the app, by rooms in view (1 / 2 / 3). balanced: 10 / 8 / 5. smooth: 20 / 10 / 8 (more CPU for the app and the mod). light: 5 / 5 / 4 (least CPU, choppier walking). The terminal uses frameRate instead.

crew.title: Crew row
crew.description: compact: one chip per crew member (name, role, a dot while working), which leaves more room for the office picture; press a chip for that member's status, counts and recent calls. cards: the larger cards with portrait, status and counts.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.description: Buttons in the pane for common requests (Run tests, Review, Commit, Status). off: no buttons. fill: a button puts its request in the prompt box, after your draft; you press Enter. send: a button sends its request to Claude at once.
